WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) as count
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
total_sum AS (
  SELECT SUM(count) as total FROM rating_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT
    rc.rating,
    rc.count,
    CAST(rc.count AS DECIMAL) / CAST(ts.total AS DECIMAL) as share
  FROM rating_counts rc
  CROSS JOIN total_sum ts
),
avg_share_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as val
  FROM with_shares
),
kept AS (
  SELECT
    ws.count,
    ws.share
  FROM with_shares ws
  WHERE ws.share > (SELECT val FROM avg_share_val)
)
SELECT
  SUM(k.count) as sum_of_counts,
  AVG(k.share) as avg_share_kept,
  AVG(k.share) - (SELECT val FROM avg_share_val) as avg_deviation
FROM kept k

assumptions.assumption: "Count the films rented" is interpreted as COUNT(*) rental records per rating, not COUNT(DISTINCT film_id). This counts how many times films of each rating were rented (rental transactions), not how many distinct films of each rating were rented.

alternatives.interpretation: "Count the films rented" means count distinct films per rating (distinct film_ids rented), rather than rental transaction count.
